observations: PRED-1238.H1 is registered 2026-01-01, a placeholder-looking date: deposit #1238 (GW.TACHYON.zenodo v7) records 'Deposited 2026-04-17T17:27:42' and discusses the three PKG deposits of 2026-04-17; its later statements in #1242 and #1243 carry the same 2026-01-01 date.

PRED-167.H2 says 'The argument does not assert that Plato and Aristotle were one biographical person', while PRED-1576.H1 states the hypothesis 'that the two corpora are one maker's sequence' and names the number of embodied makers as its external check; recorded as an apparent contradiction, not reconciled.

PRED-1570.G2 (no measured property recovered the master-student vs heteronymic distinction; 'not evidence for common authorship') stands beside PRED-1576.H1 and PRED-1571.G1 in the same investigation; it is a measurement-level negative and is not linked as a state of either.

PRED-1455.G2 (only 36-47% of teacher top-1% survives distillation; quantization costs almost nothing) is a measured result bearing on PRED-1454.G5 (blind-spot inheritance) and PRED-1454.G6 (deployment drift under quantization); linked here only by series.

Cross-group: PRED-1576.H1, PRED-1569.F6, PRED-1570.F3 and PRED-1571.G1 (group TP26.1) belong with PRED-1570.F4, PRED-1570.G2, PRED-1569.H22 and the Socrates-as-orthonym claims of group TP26.2; PRED-1576.H1 is placed in both series.

Cross-group: PRED-950.F5 (TP26.1: Pearl as maximal-coherence center, every later text generated from it) belongs with PRED-1238.H1 / PRED-668.H2 (TP26.2: Pearl as meta-heteronym that generates subsequent positions); left unlinked because 950.F5 is a computational test, not the same thesis.
Cross-group: PRED-1656.H2 (Pearl inherits Howl) and PRED-1570.F3 (Kerouac/Ginsberg test) both take Howl as object but are distinct claims; not linked.

PRED-923.G1 (self-reflexive analysis activates refusal features) and PRED-1635.G3 (reflexive latitude thins with proximity to R[O]) are thematically adjacent claims about reflexive foreclosure; left unlinked.
